question: Should OpenClaw accept `sessions.diagnose` as a durable read-only Gateway RPC and CLI contract with the proposed result/finding vocabulary?
rationale: The implementation looks bounded and read-only, but it adds a new public operator/API surface that automation should not approve without maintainer product/API intent.

options.title: Accept the contract
options.body: Merge the additive read-only diagnosis surface as the supported operator entry point for session triage.

options.title: Narrow the vocabulary first
options.body: Ask the contributor to trim or mark unstable the result fields/finding codes before exposing them as a durable protocol contract.

options.title: Defer the surface
options.body: Keep the underlying diagnostics private until a maintainer-owned session recovery/diagnosis design is approved.

recommendation.title: Accept the contract
recommendation.body: Merge the additive read-only diagnosis surface as the supported operator entry point for session triage.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal points to recent broad Gateway/session-method ownership by Peter Steinberger on adjacent current-main code.
